source_title: Elementis plc Annual Report and Accounts 2019
availability_evidence: The official annual report states on page 60 that the Strategic Report was approved by the Board on 4 March 2020; the issuer-hosted PDF was inspected page by page through the public web archive, while direct byte preservation was unavailable in the controlled environment.
observation: Weak industrial demand, customer destocking, Chromium and Energy pressure, portfolio simplification and repeated self-help actions showed material intervention pressure. The completed Coatings transformation and implemented self-help actions are excluded. Group adjusted operating margin fell 200bps to 14.1%, although Coatings margin improved to 15.1%. Sales rose to $874m, adjusted operating cash flow reached $154.8m, free cash flow rose to $90.4m, net debt fell by $43.9m to $454.2m and no covenant breaches occurred.
already_announced_exclusion: The completed Coatings transformation, Talc integration, portfolio simplification and self-help actions already implemented during 2019 are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Repeated self-help language and a 200bps Group margin decline created substantial pressure, while sales growth, sharply stronger free cash flow, lower debt and improving Coatings margin supplied meaningful quantified offsets.

source_title: Elementis plc Annual Report and Accounts 2023
availability_evidence: The official annual report states on page 73 that the Strategic Report was approved by the Board on 6 March 2024; the issuer-hosted PDF was inspected page by page through the public web archive, while direct byte preservation was unavailable in the controlled environment.
observation: Fit for the Future was an explicit organisational restructuring affecting about 190 roles or 15% of the global workforce, moving work to lower-cost locations, outsourcing processes and closing the Cologne office; a $25.4m provision was recognised. The programme was announced in September 2023 and is excluded. Despite 3% lower revenue and continued destocking, adjusted operating profit rose 3%, Group adjusted margin improved 100bps to 14.6%, free cash flow increased to $45m and net debt fell by $164.8m to $202m after the Chromium disposal.
already_announced_exclusion: The Fit for the Future restructuring, approximately 190 announced redundancies, Cologne closure, role moves and outsourcing, plus the completed Chromium disposal, were public at cutoff and are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: A large quantified restructuring met the high pressure anchor but was already announced; improving Group profit and margin, stronger free cash flow and materially lower debt provided strong contrary evidence.
